name: Studio
tagline: A quiet black workbench for agent threads: hairline sidebar, filled prompt bubbles, one bright blue.
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: theme files for color (Studio, Studio Light, Studio Ember), settings for type, chat width and sidebar rows, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the prompt bubble and cards, and a customize view for the sidebar's hover card and rows. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
